screen.eventsDescription: Join live CTF events where labs are hosted by Cyber CTF: nothing to run on your machine, each participant gets their own lab for the event's duration.

update.waitForLabs: Updating restarts Cyber CTF. Wait until your labs finish starting, stopping or pausing.
update.busyUnknown: Couldn't tell whether a lab is starting or stopping, so the update waits. Try again in a moment.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: Cyber CTF hit an unexpected error. Your labs keep running. Try again, and if it happens again, copy the details and send them to us.
error.stepDescription: This step hit an unexpected error. Try again, or go back a step. If it keeps happening, copy the details and send them to us.

terminal.noLab: This window wasn’t opened for a lab: open the shell from the lab’s page.
terminal.systemTerminalHint: Open this shell in your own terminal app

vmScreen.noViewer: The window couldn't start its screen viewer.
vmScreen.securityFailure: The machine's screen refused the password it was given.
vmScreen.lost: The connection to the machine's screen was lost.
vmScreen.unavailable: This machine has no screen to show
vmScreen.passwordCopied: Password copied: paste it when the Remote Desktop asks.
vmScreen.rdpTitle: This machine's screen opens in Remote Desktop
vmScreen.rdpHint: It opens in {client}. Keep this window open while you use it: closing it ends the connection.
vmScreen.noClient: No Remote Desktop app is installed. On a Mac, install Windows App from the App Store; on Linux, FreeRDP (xfreerdp) or Remmina. Then try again.
vmScreen.tunnelled: It goes through an encrypted SSH tunnel from this computer, which closes with this window.
vmScreen.openFailed: Couldn't open the Remote Desktop app
